faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ONGC Green CA Industrial Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the ONGC Green CA Industrial Trainee recruitment is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the CA Industrial Trainee post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the CA Industrial Trainee post in ONGC Green.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Intermediate Examination / Intermediate (IPC) Examination / Professional Competence Examination / Professional Education (Examination - II) of the ICAI, with a minimum of 70% marks in HSC (12th).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the CA Industrial Trainee position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ONGC Green CA Industrial Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the CA Industrial Trainee role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Online Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ONGC Green located?
faq.answer: The ONGC Green office is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110070.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 1/2026 (OGL).

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from all over India apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as New Delhi, Delhi. Interested candidates should check the official notification for any geographical restrictions on eligibility.
